name: MCP Reference Servers
description: The official reference MCP server collection maintained by the MCP steering group.
descriptionZh: 由 MCP steering group 维护的官方参考 MCP 服务器集合。
keyFact: The modelcontextprotocol/servers repository is the official set of reference MCP implementations, now trimmed to about seven servers (Everything, Fetch, Filesystem, Git, Memory, Sequential Thinking, Time) with the rest moved to servers-archived; the README directs users to registry.modelcontextprotocol.io for discovery, and it is mid-transition from MIT to Apache-2.0 for new contributions.
keyFactZh: modelcontextprotocol/servers 是官方参考 MCP 实现集合，现已精简至约 7 个服务器（Everything、Fetch、Filesystem、Git、Memory、Sequential Thinking、Time），其余移入 servers-archived；README 引导用户改用 registry.modelcontextprotocol.io 发现服务器，且新贡献正从 MIT 过渡到 Apache-2.0。
caveat: Repository is mid-transition between MIT and Apache-2.0; check per-file licensing before commercial reuse.
caveatZh: 仓库正处于 MIT 与 Apache-2.0 的过渡期；商用前请逐文件核对许可。
